    SELECT artist_id
    FROM artists
    WHERE genre_id = (
        SELECT genre_id
        FROM genres
        WHERE genre_name = 'Pop'
    )
),
PopSongs AS (
    SELECT song_id, artist_id

WITH AverageMonthlySMS AS (
    SELECT 
        cell_id,
        AVG(sms_in_total) AS avg_sms_in
    FROM 
        monthly_metrics
    GROUP BY 
        cell_id
),
TrafficCategories AS (
    SELECT 
        cell_id,
        avg_sms_in,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg_sms_in > 100 THEN 'High Traffic'
            WHEN avg_sms_in > 50 THEN 'Medium Traffic'
            ELSE 'Low Traffic'
        END AS traffic_category
    FROM 
        AverageMonthlySMS
)
SELECT 
    cell_id,
    traffic_category,
    COUNT(*) AS category_count
FROM 
    TrafficCategories
GROUP BY 
    cell_id,
    traffic_category
ORDER BY 
    cell_id,
    traffic_category;

sql1:
WITH RequiredSkills AS (
    SELECT
        j.industry,
        r.requirement AS required_skill,
        COUNT(*) AS required_frequency
    FROM job_requirements r
    JOIN job_postings j ON r.job_id = j.job_id
    GROUP BY j.industry, r.requirement
),
CandidateSkills AS (
    SELECT
        cs.skill,
        COUNT(*) AS candidate_skill_frequency
    FROM candidate_skills cs
    GROUP BY cs.skill
),
SkillGaps AS (
    SELECT
        rs.industry,
        rs.required_skill,
        rs.required_frequency,
        COALESCE(cs.candidate_skill_frequency, 0) AS candidate_skill_frequency,
        (rs.required_frequency - COALESCE(cs.candidate_skill_frequency, 0)) AS skill_gap
    FROM RequiredSkills rs
    LEFT JOIN CandidateSkills cs ON rs.required_skill = cs.skill
)
SELECT
    industry,
    required_skill,
    skill_gap
FROM SkillGaps
WHERE skill_gap > 0
ORDER BY industry, skill_gap DESC;

WITH REQUIREDSKILLS AS (
    SELECT
        J.INDUSTRY,
        R.REQUIREMENT AS REQUIRED_SKILL,
        COUNT(*) AS REQUIRED_FREQUENCY
    FROM JOB_REQUIREMENTS R
    JOIN JOB_POSTINGS J ON R.JOB_ID = J.JOB_ID
    GROUP BY J.INDUSTRY, R.REQUIREMENT
),
CANDIDATESKILLS AS (
    SELECT
        CS.SKILL,
        COUNT(*) AS CANDIDATE_SKILL_FREQUENCY
    FROM CANDIDATE_SKILLS CS
    GROUP BY CS.SKILL
),
SKILLGAPS AS (
    SELECT
        RS.INDUSTRY,
        RS.REQUIRED_SKILL,
        RS.REQUIRED_FREQUENCY,
        COALESCE(CS.CANDIDATE_SKILL_FREQUENCY, 0) AS CANDIDATE_SKILL_FREQUENCY,
        (RS.REQUIRED_FREQUENCY - COALESCE(CS.CANDIDATE_SKILL_FREQUENCY, 0)) AS SKILL_GAP
    FROM REQUIREDSKILLS RS
    LEFT JOIN CANDIDATESKILLS CS ON RS.REQUIRED_SKILL = CS.SKILL
)
SELECT
    INDUSTRY,
    REQUIRED_SKILL,
    SKILL_GAP
FROM SKILLGAPS
WHERE SKILL_GAP > 0
ORDER BY INDUSTRY, SKILL_GAP DESC;
WITH SKILLFREQUENCYINJOBS AS ( SELECT JP.INDUSTRY, JR.REQUIREMENT AS SKILL, COUNT(*) AS JOB_SKILL_FREQUENCY FROM JOB_POSTINGS JP JOIN JOB_REQUIREMENTS JR ON JP.JOB_ID = JR.JOB_ID GROUP BY JP.INDUSTRY, JR.REQUIREMENT ), SKILLFREQUENCYINCANDIDATES AS ( SELECT CS.SKILL, COUNT(*) AS CANDIDATE_SKILL_FREQUENCY FROM CANDIDATE_SKILLS CS GROUP BY CS.SKILL ), SKILLGAPANALYSIS AS ( SELECT SFJ.INDUSTRY, SFJ.SKILL, SFJ.JOB_SKILL_FREQUENCY, COALESCE(SFC.CANDIDATE_SKILL_FREQUENCY, 0) AS CANDIDATE_SKILL_FREQUENCY, SFJ.JOB_SKILL_FREQUENCY - COALESCE(SFC.CANDIDATE_SKILL_FREQUENCY, 0) AS SKILL_GAP FROM SKILLFREQUENCYINJOBS SFJ LEFT JOIN SKILLFREQUENCYINCANDIDATES SFC ON SFJ.SKILL = SFC.SKILL WHERE (SFJ.JOB_SKILL_FREQUENCY - COALESCE(SFC.CANDIDATE_SKILL_FREQUENCY, 0)) > 0 ) SELECT I.INDUSTRY_NAME AS INDUSTRY, SGA.SKILL, SGA.SKILL_GAP FROM SKILLGAPANALYSIS SGA JOIN INDUSTRIES I ON SGA.INDUSTRY = I.INDUSTRY_ID ORDER BY SGA.INDUSTRY, SGA.SKILL_GAP DESC;

)

WITH 
    
    SiteSupply AS (
        SELECT 
            es.site_id,
            SUM(es.capacity_mw) AS total_source_capacity
        FROM 
            energy_sources es
        GROUP BY 
            es.site_id
    ),
    
    SiteStorage AS (
        SELECT 
            es.site_id,
            SUM(es.capacity_mw) AS total_storage_capacity
        FROM 
            energy_storage es
        GROUP BY 
            es.site_id
    ),
    
    TotalSupply AS (
        SELECT 
            COALESCE(ss.site_id, st.site_id) AS site_id,
            COALESCE(ss.total_source_capacity, 0) + COALESCE(st.total_storage_capacity, 0) AS total_supply
        FROM 
            SiteSupply ss
        FULL OUTER JOIN 
            SiteStorage st ON ss.site_id = st.site_id
    ),
    
    SiteDemand AS (
        SELECT 
            ed.site_id,
            SUM(ed.actual_demand) AS total_demand
        FROM 
            electricity_demand ed
        GROUP BY 
            ed.site_id
    ),
    
    EnergyBalance AS (
        SELECT 
            COALESCE(sup.site_id, dem.site_id) AS site_id,
            COALESCE(sup.total_supply, 0) AS total_supply,
            COALESCE(dem.total_demand, 0) AS total_demand
        FROM 
            TotalSupply sup
        FULL OUTER JOIN 
            SiteDemand dem ON sup.site_id = dem.site_id
    )

SELECT 
    SUM(eb.total_demand) / SUM(eb.total_supply) AS demand_to_supply_ratio
FROM 
    EnergyBalance eb;

      COUNT(CASE WHEN class = 1 THEN 1 END) as heart_disease_patients,
      MIN(age) as min_age,
      MAX(age) as max_age,
      AVG(height) as avg_height,
      AVG(weight) as avg_weight
    FROM patients
  ),
  
  medication_stats AS (
    SELECT 
      COUNT(*) as total_medications,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN medication_name = 'Aspirin' THEN 1 END) as aspirin_count
    FROM medications
  ),
  
  symptom_stats AS (
    SELECT 
      COUNT(*) as total_symptoms,
      patient_id, 
      COUNT(*) as symptom_count
    FROM patient_symptoms
    GROUP BY patient_id
    ORDER BY symptom_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  
  emergency_contact_stats AS (
    SELECT 
      COUNT(*) as total_contacts,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN relationship = 'family' THEN 1 END) as family_contacts

      COUNT(*) as total_insurance,

    SELECT 
      AVG(rest_blood_pressure) as avg_bp

  )

WITH ANALYSTREPORTFEEDBACK AS ( SELECT R.REPORT_ID, AVG(F.FEEDBACK_RATING) AS AVG_FEEDBACK_RATING FROM REPORTS R JOIN USERS U ON R.GENERATED_BY = U.USER_ID JOIN USER_ROLES UR ON U.USER_ID = UR.USER_ID JOIN FEEDBACK F ON R.REPORT_ID = F.REPORT_ID WHERE UR.ROLE_ID = (SELECT ROLE_ID FROM ROLES WHERE ROLE_NAME = 'ANALYST') GROUP BY R.REPORT_ID ) SELECT MIN(AVG_FEEDBACK_RATING) AS MIN_AVG_FEEDBACK_RATING FROM ANALYSTREPORTFEEDBACK;
WITH ANALYSTREPORTS AS (
    SELECT 
        R.REPORT_ID
    FROM REPORTS R
    JOIN USERS U ON R.GENERATED_BY = U.USER_ID
    WHERE U.ROLE = 'ANALYST'
),
AVERAGEFEEDBACK AS (
    SELECT 
        F.REPORT_ID,
        AVG(F.FEEDBACK_RATING) AS AVG_FEEDBACK
    FROM FEEDBACK F
    JOIN ANALYSTREPORTS AR ON F.REPORT_ID = AR.REPORT_ID
    GROUP BY F.REPORT_ID
)
SELECT 
    MIN(AVG_FEEDBACK) AS MINIMUM_AVERAGE_FEEDBACK_RATING
FROM 
    AVERAGEFEEDBACK;

WITH ProductSalesSummary AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.product_title,
        m.marketplace_name,
        SUM(ps.units_sold) AS total_units_sold,
        AVG(ps.revenue) AS average_revenue
    FROM
        products p
    JOIN
        product_sales ps ON p.product_id = ps.product_id
    JOIN
        marketplaces m ON ps.marketplace_id = m.marketplace_id
    GROUP BY
        p.product_id, p.product_title, m.marketplace_name
),
CustomerReviewsSummary AS (
    SELECT
        r.review_id,
        r.customer_id,
        r.product_id,
        r.star_rating,
        CASE WHEN r.verified_purchase = 1 THEN 'verified' ELSE 'non-verified' END AS purchase_status
    FROM
        reviews r
    WHERE
        r.verified_purchase = 1 
),
CustomerFeedbackSummary AS (
    SELECT
        cf.review_id,
        cf.feedback_text,
        cf.rating AS feedback_rating,
        cf.follow_up_required
    FROM
        customer_feedback cf
),
ProductAndReviewPerformance AS (
    SELECT
        pss.product_id,
        pss.product_title,
        pss.marketplace_name,
        pss.total_units_sold,
        pss.average_revenue,
        crs.star_rating,
        cfs.feedback_rating,
        cfs.follow_up_required
    FROM
        ProductSalesSummary pss
    LEFT JOIN
        CustomerReviewsSummary crs ON pss.product_id = crs.product_id
    LEFT JOIN
        CustomerFeedbackSummary cfs ON crs.review_id = cfs.review_id
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    product_title,
    marketplace_name,
    total_units_sold,
    average_revenue,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN follow_up_required = 1 THEN 1 END) AS required_follow_up_count,
    AVG(star_rating) AS average_customer_rating,
    AVG(feedback_rating) AS average_feedback_rating
FROM
    ProductAndReviewPerformance
GROUP BY
    product_id, product_title, marketplace_name, total_units_sold, average_revenue
ORDER BY
    required_follow_up_count DESC, average_customer_rating DESC;

ad.total_expenses) as net_profit, (ad.total_sales - ad.total_expenses - ad.total_depreciation - ad.total_interest) as operating_income FROM AggregatedData ad INNER JOIN financial_reports fr ON ad.company_id = fr.company_id AND ad.report_date = fr.report_date INNER JOIN companies c ON ad.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN PerformanceScores ps ON ps.report_id = fr.report_id LEFT JOIN ExternalTrends et ON et.date = ad.report_date ORDER BY c.company_name, ad.report_date;

WITH 
  AverageRatings AS (
    SELECT 
      show_id, 
      AVG(rating_value) AS average_rating
    FROM 
      ratings
    GROUP BY 
      show_id
  ),
  
  TotalViewership AS (
    SELECT 
      show_id, 
      SUM(viewer_count) AS total_viewer_count
    FROM 
      viewership
    GROUP BY 
      show_id
  ),
  
  ShowDetails AS (
    SELECT 
      s.show_id, 
      s.title, 
      n.network_name
    FROM 
      shows s
    INNER JOIN 
      network_shows ns ON s.show_id = ns.show_id
    INNER JOIN 
      networks n ON ns.network_id = n.network_id
  )

SELECT 
  sd.title, 
  sd.network_name
FROM 
  ShowDetails sd
INNER JOIN 
  AverageRatings ar ON sd.show_id = ar.show_id
INNER JOIN 
  TotalViewership tv ON sd.show_id = tv.show_id
ORDER BY 
  ar.average_rating DESC, 
  tv.total_viewer_count DESC

        AVG(property_crime_rate) * 1.5 AS weighted_property_crime_rates

FROM

WITH OverallAverageResponseTime AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(avg_response_time) as avg_response_time
    FROM packet_statistics
),
ErrorRateThreshold AS (
    SELECT 
        t.packet_id, 
        t.threshold_value
    FROM thresholds t
    WHERE t.threshold_type = 'error rate'
),
FilteredPackets AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.packet_id,
        ps.error_count,
        ps.total_transmissions,
        ps.avg_response_time,
        (ps.error_count * 1.0 / ps.total_transmissions) as error_rate
    FROM packet_statistics ps
    JOIN ErrorRateThreshold et ON ps.packet_id = et.packet_id
    WHERE (ps.error_count * 1.0 / ps.total_transmissions) > et.threshold_value
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT fp.packet_id) as total_packets_exceeding_threshold
FROM FilteredPackets fp
CROSS JOIN OverallAverageResponseTime oart
WHERE fp.avg_response_time < oart.avg_response_time;

WITH

        SUM(goals) AS total_goals
    FROM player_statistics
    GROUP BY player_id
),

TotalPenaltyMinutes AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(penalty_minutes) AS total_penalty_minutes
    FROM game_statistics
    GROUP BY player_id
),

TotalPowerPlayGoals AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(power_play_goals) AS total_power_play_goals
    FROM player_statistics
    GROUP BY player_id
),

AverageFaceoffPercentage AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        AVG(faceoff_percentage) AS average_faceoff_percentage
    FROM game_statistics
    GROUP BY player_id
)

SELECT 
    p.player_name, 
    tg.total_goals,
    tpm.total_penalty_minutes,
    tppg.total_power_play_goals,
    afp.average_faceoff_percentage,
    (tg.total_goals + tppg.total_power_play_goals) AS total_score
FROM players p
JOIN TotalGoals tg ON p.player_id = tg.player_id
JOIN TotalPenaltyMinutes tpm ON p.player_id = tpm.player_id
JOIN TotalPowerPlayGoals tppg ON p.player_id = tppg.player_id
JOIN AverageFaceoffPercentage afp ON p.player_id = afp.player_id
ORDER BY total_score DESC;

JOIN TOTALPENALTYMINUTES TPM ON P.PLAYER_ID = TPM.PLAYER_ID
JOIN TOTALPOWERPLAYGOALS TPPG ON P.PLAYER_ID = TPPG.PLAYER_ID

WITH LatestMeasurements AS (
    SELECT 
        m.device_id,
        MAX(m.measurement_date) AS latest_measurement_date
    FROM measurements m
    GROUP BY m.device_id

LatestVersions AS (
    SELECT 
        dv.device_id,
        MAX(dv.version_date) AS latest_version_date
    FROM device_versions dv
    GROUP BY dv.device_id
)

    SELECT 
        M.DEVICE_ID,
        MAX(M.MEASUREMENT_DATE) AS LATEST_MEASUREMENT_DATE
    FROM MEASUREMENTS M
    GROUP BY M.DEVICE_ID
),
LATESTVERSIONS AS (
    SELECT 
        DV.DEVICE_ID,
        MAX(DV.VERSION_DATE) AS LATEST_VERSION_DATE
    FROM DEVICE_VERSIONS DV
    GROUP BY DV.DEVICE_ID
)
SELECT 
    M.DEVICE_ID,
    P.PARAMETER_NAME,
    M.VALUE AS MEASURED_VALUE,
    M.MEASUREMENT_DATE,
    DV.VERSION_NUMBER,
    DV.VERSION_DATE,
    U.USER_NAME,
    R.ROLE_NAME
FROM MEASUREMENTS M
JOIN LATESTMEASUREMENTS LM ON M.DEVICE_ID = LM.DEVICE_ID AND M.MEASUREMENT_DATE = LM.LATEST_MEASUREMENT_DATE
JOIN PARAMETERS P ON M.PARAMETER_ID = P.PARAMETER_ID
JOIN DEVICE_VERSIONS DV ON M.DEVICE_ID = DV.DEVICE_ID AND DV.VERSION_DATE = (
    SELECT LATEST_VERSION_DATE FROM LATESTVERSIONS LV WHERE LV.DEVICE_ID = M.DEVICE_ID
)
JOIN USERS U ON DV.CREATED_BY_USER_ID = U.USER_ID

WITH UsageAndChurn AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.email,
        c.tenure,
        SUM(su.usage_duration) AS total_usage_duration,
        MAX(cp.churn_probability) AS churn_probability,
        AVG(pr.redemption_value) AS avg_redemption_value
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN service_usage su ON c.customer_id = su.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN churn_predictions cp ON c.customer_id = cp.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN promotion_redemptions pr ON c.customer_id = pr.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.email, c.tenure
)
SELECT
    email,
    churn_probability,
    avg_redemption_value
FROM UsageAndChurn
WHERE tenure > 10 AND total_usage_duration > 500
ORDER BY email, churn_probability DESC, avg_redemption_value DESC;
sql2: WITH UsageSummary AS ( SELECT customer_id, SUM(usage_duration) AS total_usage_duration FROM service_usage GROUP BY customer_id ), RecentChurnPredictions AS ( SELECT cp.customer_id, cp.churn_probability FROM churn_predictions cp INNER JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, MAX(prediction_date) AS latest_prediction_date FROM churn_predictions GROUP BY customer_id ) cp_latest ON cp.customer_id = cp_latest.customer_id AND cp.prediction_date = cp_latest.latest_prediction_date ), RedemptionSummary AS ( SELECT pr.customer_id, AVG(pr.redemption_value) AS avg_redemption_value FROM promotion_redemptions pr GROUP BY pr.customer_id ) SELECT c.email, rc.churn_probability, rs.avg_redemption_value FROM UsageSummary us JOIN RecentChurnPredictions rc ON us.customer_id = rc.customer_id JOIN RedemptionSummary rs ON us.customer_id = rs.customer_id JOIN customers c ON us.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE us.total_usage_duration > 500 AND c.tenure > 10 ORDER BY c.email, rc.churn_probability DESC, rs.avg_redemption_value DESC;

    SELECT
        C.CUSTOMER_ID,
        C.EMAIL,
        C.TENURE,
        SUM(SU.USAGE_DURATION) AS TOTAL_USAGE_DURATION,

)

WITH 
-- Calculate average ratings of each show
ShowAverageRatings AS (
    SELECT show_id, AVG(rating) AS average_rating
    FROM ratings
    GROUP BY show_id
),

-- Count the number of reviews for each show
ShowReviewCount AS (
    SELECT show_id, COUNT(review_id) AS total_reviews
    FROM reviews
    GROUP BY show_id
),

-- Rank shows by average rating and total reviews, then select top 10
TopShows AS (
    SELECT sar.show_id, sar.average_rating, src.total_reviews
    FROM ShowAverageRatings sar
    INNER JOIN ShowReviewCount src ON sar.show_id = src.show_id
    ORDER BY sar.average_rating DESC, src.total_reviews DESC
    LIMIT 10
),

-- Count appearances of each guest on top shows
GuestAppearanceCount AS (
    SELECT a.guest_id, COUNT(a.appearance_id) AS total_appearances
    FROM appearances a
    INNER JOIN TopShows ts ON a.show_id = ts.show_id
    GROUP BY a.guest_id
)

-- Get guest names and their appearance counts on top shows
SELECT g.name, gac.total_appearances
FROM guests g
INNER JOIN GuestAppearanceCount gac ON g.guest_id = gac.guest_id
ORDER BY gac.total_appearances DESC;
sql2: WITH TopRatedShows AS ( SELECT s.show_id, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(rev.review_id) AS review_count FROM shows s JOIN ratings r ON s.show_id = r.show_id JOIN reviews rev ON s.show_id = rev.show_id GROUP BY s.show_id ORDER BY average_rating DESC, review_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT g.name AS guest_name, COUNT(a.appearance_id) AS num_appearances FROM guests g JOIN appearances a ON g.guest_id = a.guest_id JOIN TopRatedShows trs ON a.show_id = trs.show_id GROUP BY g.name HAVING COUNT(a.appearance_id) > 0 ORDER BY num_appearances DESC;

        SUM(CASE WHEN result_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_tests,

    FROM lab_results
),

    ab.avg_birth_weight_gm,
    tlt.total_lab_tests,
    lts.completed_tests,
    lts.pending_tests,
    tm.total_medications_prescribed,
    sa.scheduled_appointments
FROM PatientCount pc
CROSS JOIN PrematureBirths pb
CROSS JOIN AvgBirthWeight ab
CROSS JOIN TotalLabTests tlt
CROSS JOIN LabTestStatus lts

WITH CUSTOMERRETURNSSUMMARY AS ( SELECT O.CUSTOMER_ID, OI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, OI.SIZE_ID, SUM(R.RETURN_QUANTITY) AS RETURN_QUANTITY FROM RETURNS R JOIN ORDERS O ON R.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID GROUP BY O.CUSTOMER_ID, OI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, OI.SIZE_ID ), CUSTOMERORDERSSUMMARY AS ( SELECT O.CUSTOMER_ID, OI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, OI.SIZE_ID, SUM(OI.QUANTITY) AS ORDER_QUANTITY FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID GROUP BY O.CUSTOMER_ID, OI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, OI.SIZE_ID ), INVENTORYSUMMARY AS ( SELECT IV.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, IV.SIZE_ID, SUM(IV.QUANTITY) AS STOCK FROM INVENTORY IV GROUP BY IV.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, IV.SIZE_ID ) SELECT CR.CUSTOMER_ID, CR.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, CR.SIZE_ID, (COALESCE(CR.RETURN_QUANTITY, 0) + COALESCE(I.STOCK, 0) - COALESCE(CO.ORDER_QUANTITY, 0)) AS ADJUSTED_STOCK FROM CUSTOMERRETURNSSUMMARY CR FULL OUTER JOIN CUSTOMERORDERSSUMMARY CO ON CR.CUSTOMER_ID = CO.CUSTOMER_ID AND CR.GARMENT_TYPE_ID = CO.GARMENT_TYPE_ID AND CR.SIZE_ID = CO.SIZE_ID FULL OUTER JOIN INVENTORYSUMMARY I ON (CR.GARMENT_TYPE_ID = I.GARMENT_TYPE_ID AND CR.SIZE_ID = I.SIZE_ID) OR (CO.GARMENT_TYPE_ID = I.GARMENT_TYPE_ID AND CO.SIZE_ID = I.SIZE_ID) ORDER BY CR.CUSTOMER_ID, CR.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, CR.SIZE_ID;
WITH RETURNEDITEMS AS (
  SELECT O.CUSTOMER_ID,
         OI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID,
         OI.SIZE_ID,
         SUM(R.RETURN_QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_RETURNED_QUANTITY
  FROM RETURNS R
  JOIN ORDERS O ON R.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID
  JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID
  GROUP BY O.CUSTOMER_ID, OI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, OI.SIZE_ID
),
ORDEREDITEMS AS (
  SELECT O.CUSTOMER_ID,
         OI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID,
         OI.SIZE_ID,
         SUM(OI.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_ORDERED_QUANTITY
  FROM ORDERS O
  JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID
  GROUP BY O.CUSTOMER_ID, OI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, OI.SIZE_ID
),
INVENTORYDETAILS AS (
  SELECT I.GARMENT_TYPE_ID,
         I.SIZE_ID,
         I.QUANTITY AS CURRENT_STOCK
  FROM INVENTORY I
)
SELECT RI.CUSTOMER_ID,
       RI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID,
       RI.SIZE_ID,
       (ID.CURRENT_STOCK + COALESCE(RI.TOTAL_RETURNED_QUANTITY, 0) - COALESCE(OI.TOTAL_ORDERED_QUANTITY, 0)) AS ADJUSTED_STOCK
FROM RETURNEDITEMS RI
FULL OUTER JOIN ORDEREDITEMS OI ON RI.CUSTOMER_ID = OI.CUSTOMER_ID AND RI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID = OI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID AND RI.SIZE_ID = OI.SIZE_ID
JOIN INVENTORYDETAILS ID ON RI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID = ID.GARMENT_TYPE_ID AND RI.SIZE_ID = ID.SIZE_ID
ORDER BY RI.CUSTOMER_ID, RI.GARMENT_TYPE_ID, RI.SIZE_ID;

sql1: WITH GameCounts AS ( SELECT t.team_id, t.team_name, COUNT(g.game_id) AS total_games, SUM(CASE WHEN g.home_team_id = t.team_id AND g.home_team_score > g.away_team_score THEN 1 WHEN g.away_team_id = t.team_id AND g.away_team_score > g.home_team_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wins, SUM(CASE WHEN g.home_team_id = t.team_id AND g.home_team_score < g.away_team_score THEN 1 WHEN g.away_team_id = t.team_id AND g.away_team_score < g.home_team_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_losses, AVG(g.attendance) AS avg_attendance FROM teams t LEFT JOIN games g ON t.team_id = g.home_team_id OR t.team_id = g.away_team_id GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_name ), AverageScores AS ( SELECT g.home_team_id AS team_id, AVG(g.home_team_score) AS avg_home_score, AVG(g.away_team_score) AS avg_away_score FROM games g GROUP BY g.home_team_id ), CoachExperience AS ( SELECT t.team_id, AVG(c.experience_years) AS avg_coach_experience FROM teams t JOIN coaches c ON t.coach_id = c.coach_id GROUP BY t.team_id ) SELECT gc.team_name, gc.total_games, gc.total_wins, gc.total_losses, gc.avg_attendance, COALESCE(asr.avg_home_score, 0) AS avg_home_score, COALESCE(asr.avg_away_score, 0) AS avg_away_score, COALESCE(ce.avg_coach_experience, 0) AS avg_coach_experience FROM GameCounts gc LEFT JOIN AverageScores asr ON gc.team_id = asr.team_id LEFT JOIN CoachExperience ce ON gc.team_id = ce.team_id ORDER BY gc.total_wins DESC, gc.total_losses ASC, gc.avg_attendance DESC;

sql1:
SELECT 
    u.user_name AS user_name,
    COUNT(i.issue_id) AS total_issues,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'Resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_issues,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(CASE WHEN i.priority = 'High' THEN 1.0
                      WHEN i.priority = 'Medium' THEN 2.0
                      WHEN i.priority = 'Low' THEN 3.0
                      ELSE 0 END) <= 1.5 THEN 'High'
        WHEN AVG(CASE WHEN i.priority = 'High' THEN 1.0
                      WHEN i.priority = 'Medium' THEN 2.0
                      WHEN i.priority = 'Low' THEN 3.0
                      ELSE 0 END) <= 2.5 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS average_priority_label
FROM 
    issues i
JOIN 
    users u ON i.owner = u.user_name
GROUP BY 
    u.user_name
ORDER BY 
    total_issues DESC;
sql2: WITH user_issue_stats AS ( SELECT u.user_name, COUNT(i.issue_id) AS total_issues, SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'Resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_issues, AVG(CASE WHEN i.priority = 'High' THEN 1.0 WHEN i.priority = 'Medium' THEN 2.0 WHEN i.priority = 'Low' THEN 3.0 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_priority_value FROM users u JOIN issues i ON u.user_name = i.owner GROUP BY u.user_name ) SELECT user_name, total_issues, resolved_issues, CASE WHEN avg_priority_value <= 1.5 THEN 'High' WHEN avg_priority_value <= 2.5 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS average_priority_label FROM user_issue_stats ORDER BY total_issues DESC;

    FROM requests
    WHERE priority = 'High' AND date_closed IS NOT NULL

DocumentCounts AS (
    SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) AS document_count
    FROM request_documents
    WHERE request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM HighPriorityClosedRequests)
    GROUP BY request_id
),
StatusUpdateCounts AS (
    SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) AS status_update_count
    FROM request_status
    WHERE request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM HighPriorityClosedRequests)
    GROUP BY request_id
),

    SELECT request_id, COUNT(*) AS history_count

    WHERE request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM HighPriorityClosedRequests)

)

    COALESCE(SUM(status_update_count), 0) AS total_status_updates,
    COALESCE(SUM(history_count), 0) AS total_history_records
FROM 
    HighPriorityClosedRequests
    LEFT JOIN DocumentCounts USING (request_id)
    LEFT JOIN StatusUpdateCounts USING (request_id)

WITH AgentRewards AS (
    SELECT
        a.experiment_id,
        AVG(r.reward_value) AS avg_reward
    FROM
        agents a
    INNER JOIN
        actions ac ON a.agent_id = ac.agent_id
    INNER JOIN
        rewards r ON ac.action_id = r.action_id
    GROUP BY
        a.experiment_id
),
ExperimentMetrics AS (
    SELECT
        a.experiment_id,
        COUNT(a.agent_id) AS agent_count,
        SUM(ac.action_id) AS total_actions,
        ar.avg_reward
    FROM
        agents a
    INNER JOIN
        actions ac ON a.agent_id = ac.agent_id
    INNER JOIN
        AgentRewards ar ON a.experiment_id = ar.experiment_id
    GROUP BY
        a.experiment_id, ar.avg_reward
)
SELECT
    em.experiment_id,
    ((em.avg_reward * em.total_actions) / em.agent_count) AS performance_metric
FROM
    ExperimentMetrics em;

  FROM contributions

),

  SELECT 
    user_id,
    module_id,

  FROM contributions
  GROUP BY user_id, module_id
),

    umc.user_id,

)

    FROM 
      campaigns
    WHERE

SELECT
    g.season,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.team = g.home_team THEN g.home_team 
        WHEN p.team = g.away_team THEN g.away_team 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS team_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pgm.player_id) AS total_players,
    SUM(pgm.minutes_played) AS total_minutes_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pgm.substitution_in_time > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_substitutions_in,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pgm.substitution_out_time > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_substitutions_out,
    SUM(pgm.yellow_card) AS total_yellow_cards,
    SUM(pgm.red_card) AS total_red_cards,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pgm.injured = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_injuries
FROM 
    player_game_map pgm
JOIN 
    games g ON pgm.game_id = g.game_id
JOIN 
    players p ON pgm.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE 
    p.team IN (g.home_team, g.away_team)
GROUP BY 
    g.season, 
    CASE 
        WHEN p.team = g.home_team THEN g.home_team 
        WHEN p.team = g.away_team THEN g.away_team 
        ELSE NULL 
    END
ORDER BY 
    g.season, 
    team_name;

    CASE 
        WHEN P.TEAM = G.HOME_TEAM THEN G.HOME_TEAM 
        WHEN P.TEAM = G.AWAY_TEAM THEN G.AWAY_TEAM 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS TEAM_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PGM.PLAYER_ID) AS TOTAL_PLAYERS,
    SUM(PGM.MINUTES_PLAYED) AS TOTAL_MINUTES_PLAYED,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PGM.SUBSTITUTION_IN_TIME > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_SUBSTITUTIONS_IN,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PGM.SUBSTITUTION_OUT_TIME > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_SUBSTITUTIONS_OUT,
    SUM(PGM.YELLOW_CARD) AS TOTAL_YELLOW_CARDS,
    SUM(PGM.RED_CARD) AS TOTAL_RED_CARDS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PGM.INJURED = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_INJURIES
FROM 
    PLAYER_GAME_MAP PGM
JOIN 
    GAMES G ON PGM.GAME_ID = G.GAME_ID
JOIN 
    PLAYERS P ON PGM.PLAYER_ID = P.PLAYER_ID
WHERE 
    P.TEAM IN (G.HOME_TEAM, G.AWAY_TEAM)
GROUP BY 
    G.SEASON, 
    CASE 
        WHEN P.TEAM = G.HOME_TEAM THEN G.HOME_TEAM 
        WHEN P.TEAM = G.AWAY_TEAM THEN G.AWAY_TEAM 
        ELSE NULL 
    END

WITH CustomerAverageFees AS (
  -- Calculate the average monthly fee for each customer.
  SELECT 
    b.user_id,
    AVG(b.total_fee) AS average_monthly_fee
  FROM 
    billing b
  GROUP BY 
    b.user_id
),

HighAverageFeeCustomers AS (
  -- Get the top 10 customers with the highest average monthly fees.
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    average_monthly_fee
  FROM 
    CustomerAverageFees
  ORDER BY 
    average_monthly_fee DESC
  LIMIT 10
),

LowAverageFeeCustomers AS (
  -- Get the bottom 10 customers with the lowest average monthly fees.
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    average_monthly_fee
  FROM 
    CustomerAverageFees
  ORDER BY 
    average_monthly_fee ASC
  LIMIT 10
)

-- Combine the results and categorize them appropriately.
SELECT 
  'Highest Average Fee' AS category,
  user_id,
  average_monthly_fee
FROM 
  HighAverageFeeCustomers
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Lowest Average Fee' AS category,
  user_id,
  average_monthly_fee
FROM 
  LowAverageFeeCustomers;

sql2:
WITH TeamTournamentCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name, 
        m.tournament_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN m.winner_id = t.team_id THEN 1 END) AS win_count,
        COUNT(m.match_id) AS total_count
    FROM 
        teams t
    JOIN 
        matches m ON t.team_id = m.winner_id OR t.team_id = m.loser_id
    GROUP BY 
        t.team_id,
        m.tournament_id
),
TeamTournamentWinRatio AS (
    SELECT 
        team_id,
        team_name, 
        tournament_id,
        ROUND(1.0 * win_count / total_count, 2) AS win_ratio
    FROM 
        TeamTournamentCounts
    WHERE 
        total_count > 0  -- Avoid division by zero
)
SELECT 
    ttr.team_name,
    t.year, 
    t.name as tournament_name, 
    ttr.win_ratio
FROM 
    TeamTournamentWinRatio ttr
JOIN 
    tournaments t ON ttr.tournament_id = t.tournament_id
ORDER BY 
    t.year DESC, 
    ttr.win_ratio DESC;

    SELECT 
        T.TEAM_ID,
        T.TEAM_NAME, 
        M.TOURNAMENT_ID,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN M.WINNER_ID = T.TEAM_ID THEN 1 END) AS WIN_COUNT,
        COUNT(M.MATCH_ID) AS TOTAL_COUNT
    FROM 
        TEAMS T
    JOIN 
        MATCHES M ON T.TEAM_ID = M.WINNER_ID OR T.TEAM_ID = M.LOSER_ID
    GROUP BY 
        T.TEAM_ID,
        M.TOURNAMENT_ID
),
TEAMTOURNAMENTWINRATIO AS (
    SELECT 
        TEAM_ID,
        TEAM_NAME, 
        TOURNAMENT_ID,
        ROUND(1.0 * WIN_COUNT / TOTAL_COUNT, 2) AS WIN_RATIO
    FROM 
        TEAMTOURNAMENTCOUNTS
    WHERE 
        TOTAL_COUNT > 0  -- AVOID DIVISION BY ZERO
)

    GROUP BY bs.borough_id
),

    SELECT
        rf.borough_id,
        rf.resident_name,

        rf.feedback_date

        SELECT borough_id, MAX(feedback_date) AS latest_feedback_date

sql1: WITH AggregatedData AS ( SELECT di.device_type, gl.country, pv.page_name, SUM(es.engagement_actions) AS total_engagement_actions, COUNT(sq.query_id) AS search_count FROM user_sessions es JOIN device_information di ON es.session_id = di.session_id JOIN geo_location gl ON es.session_id = gl.session_id LEFT JOIN page_views pv ON es.session_id = pv.session_id LEFT JOIN search_queries sq ON es.session_id = sq.session_id GROUP BY di.device_type, gl.country, pv.page_name ), EngagementVsSearch AS ( SELECT device_type, country, page_name, total_engagement_actions / search_count AS avg_engagement_actions_per_search FROM AggregatedData ) SELECT MAX(avg_engagement_actions_per_search) AS max_avg_engagement_actions_per_search FROM EngagementVsSearch;

WITH EngagementActionsPerSearch AS (
    SELECT 
        di.device_type,
        gl.country,
        pv.page_name,
        AVG(em.count) AS avg_engagement_actions,
        COUNT(sq.query_id) AS total_searches
    FROM 
        device_information di
    JOIN 
        user_sessions us ON di.session_id = us.session_id
    JOIN 
        geo_location gl ON us.session_id = gl.session_id
    JOIN 
        page_views pv ON us.session_id = pv.session_id
    JOIN 
        engagement_metrics em ON pv.view_id = em.page_id
    JOIN 
        search_queries sq ON us.session_id = sq.session_id
    GROUP BY 
        di.device_type, 
        gl.country, 
        pv.page_name
),
CalculatedMetrics AS (
    SELECT 
        device_type,
        country,
        page_name,
        avg_engagement_actions / total_searches AS avg_engagement_actions_per_search
    FROM 
        EngagementActionsPerSearch
)
SELECT 
    MAX(avg_engagement_actions_per_search) AS max_avg_engagement_actions_per_search
FROM 
    CalculatedMetrics;

WITH ENGAGEMENTACTIONSPERSEARCH AS (
    SELECT 
        DI.DEVICE_TYPE,
        GL.COUNTRY,
        PV.PAGE_NAME,
        AVG(EM.COUNT) AS AVG_ENGAGEMENT_ACTIONS,
        COUNT(SQ.QUERY_ID) AS TOTAL_SEARCHES
    FROM 
        DEVICE_INFORMATION DI
    JOIN 
        USER_SESSIONS US ON DI.SESSION_ID = US.SESSION_ID
    JOIN 
        GEO_LOCATION GL ON US.SESSION_ID = GL.SESSION_ID
    JOIN 
        PAGE_VIEWS PV ON US.SESSION_ID = PV.SESSION_ID
    JOIN 
        ENGAGEMENT_METRICS EM ON PV.VIEW_ID = EM.PAGE_ID
    JOIN 
        SEARCH_QUERIES SQ ON US.SESSION_ID = SQ.SESSION_ID

        DI.DEVICE_TYPE, 
        GL.COUNTRY, 
        PV.PAGE_NAME
),
CALCULATEDMETRICS AS (
    SELECT 
        DEVICE_TYPE,
        COUNTRY,
        PAGE_NAME,

    FROM 
        ENGAGEMENTACTIONSPERSEARCH
)
SELECT 
    MAX(AVG_ENGAGEMENT_ACTIONS_PER_SEARCH) AS MAX_AVG_ENGAGEMENT_ACTIONS_PER_SEARCH
FROM 
    CALCULATEDMETRICS;

  SELECT 
    D.STATE_CODE,

WITH UserAnalyses AS (
  SELECT 
    d.owner_id AS user_id,
    COUNT(a.analysis_id) AS total_analyses
  FROM analyses a
  INNER JOIN datasets d ON a.dataset_id = d.dataset_id
  GROUP BY d.owner_id
),
UserCollaborations AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_id,
    COUNT(c.collaboration_id) AS total_collaborations
  FROM collaborations c
  GROUP BY c.user_id
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(ua.user_id, uc.user_id) AS user_id,
  COALESCE(u.user_name, '') AS user_name,
  COALESCE(ua.total_analyses, 0) + COALESCE(uc.total_collaborations, 0) AS total_interactions
FROM UserAnalyses ua
FULL OUTER JOIN UserCollaborations uc
ON ua.user_id = uc.user_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON COALESCE(ua.user_id, uc.user_id) = u.user_id
ORDER BY total_interactions DESC;

WITH TOPCOMPANIES AS ( SELECT COMPANY_ID, NAME, MARKET_CAP FROM COMPANIES ORDER BY MARKET_CAP DESC LIMIT 10 ), FINANCIALDATASUMMARY AS ( SELECT COMPANY_ID, AVG(REVENUE) AS AVG_REVENUE, AVG(NET_INCOME) AS AVG_NET_INCOME FROM COMPANY_FINANCIALS WHERE FISCAL_YEAR >= (SELECT MAX(FISCAL_YEAR) - 2 FROM COMPANY_FINANCIALS) GROUP BY COMPANY_ID ), PRESSRELEASESTATS AS ( SELECT COMPANY_ID, COUNT(*) AS PRESS_RELEASES_COUNT FROM PRESS_RELEASES GROUP BY COMPANY_ID ), NEWSARTICLESTATS AS ( SELECT COMPANY_ID, COUNT(*) AS NEWS_ARTICLES_COUNT FROM NEWS_ARTICLES GROUP BY COMPANY_ID ), WATCHLISTSTATS AS ( SELECT COMPANY_ID, COUNT(*) AS WATCHLIST_COUNT FROM WATCHLISTS GROUP BY COMPANY_ID ), RATINGSTATS AS ( SELECT COMPANY_ID, AVG(RATING) AS AVG_RATING FROM RATINGS GROUP BY COMPANY_ID ) SELECT TC.NAME, TC.MARKET_CAP, COALESCE(FDS.AVG_REVENUE, 0) AS AVG_REVENUE, COALESCE(FDS.AVG_NET_INCOME, 0) AS AVG_NET_INCOME, COALESCE(PRS.PRESS_RELEASES_COUNT, 0) AS PRESS_RELEASES_COUNT, COALESCE(NAS.NEWS_ARTICLES_COUNT, 0) AS NEWS_ARTICLES_COUNT, COALESCE(WLS.WATCHLIST_COUNT, 0) AS WATCHLIST_COUNT, COALESCE(RS.AVG_RATING, 0) AS AVG_RATING FROM TOPCOMPANIES TC LEFT JOIN FINANCIALDATASUMMARY FDS ON TC.COMPANY_ID = FDS.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN PRESSRELEASESTATS PRS ON TC.COMPANY_ID = PRS.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN NEWSARTICLESTATS NAS ON TC.COMPANY_ID = NAS.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN WATCHLISTSTATS WLS ON TC.COMPANY_ID = WLS.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN RATINGSTATS RS ON TC.COMPANY_ID = RS.COMPANY_ID ORDER BY TC.MARKET_CAP DESC;
WITH TOPCOMPANIES AS ( SELECT COMPANY_ID, NAME, MARKET_CAP FROM COMPANIES ORDER BY MARKET_CAP DESC LIMIT 10 ), FINANCIALSUMMARY AS ( SELECT FC.COMPANY_ID, AVG(FC.REVENUE) AS AVG_REVENUE, AVG(FC.NET_INCOME) AS AVG_NET_INCOME FROM COMPANY_FINANCIALS FC WHERE FC.COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT COMPANY_ID FROM TOPCOMPANIES) AND FC.FISCAL_YEAR >= (SELECT MAX(FISCAL_YEAR) - 2 FROM COMPANY_FINANCIALS) GROUP BY FC.COMPANY_ID ), PRESSRELEASESCOUNT AS ( SELECT PR.COMPANY_ID, COUNT(PR.RELEASE_ID) AS PRESS_RELEASES_COUNT FROM PRESS_RELEASES PR WHERE PR.COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT COMPANY_ID FROM TOPCOMPANIES) GROUP BY PR.COMPANY_ID ), NEWSARTICLESCOUNT AS ( SELECT NA.COMPANY_ID, COUNT(NA.ARTICLE_ID) AS NEWS_ARTICLES_COUNT FROM NEWS_ARTICLES NA WHERE NA.COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT COMPANY_ID FROM TOPCOMPANIES) GROUP BY NA.COMPANY_ID ), WATCHLISTCOUNT AS ( SELECT W.COMPANY_ID, COUNT(W.WATCHLIST_ID) AS WATCHLIST_COUNT FROM WATCHLISTS W WHERE W.COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT COMPANY_ID FROM TOPCOMPANIES) GROUP BY W.COMPANY_ID ), RATINGSSUMMARY AS ( SELECT R.COMPANY_ID, AVG(R.RATING) AS AVG_RATING FROM RATINGS R WHERE R.COMPANY_ID IN (SELECT COMPANY_ID FROM TOPCOMPANIES) GROUP BY R.COMPANY_ID ) SELECT TC.NAME, TC.MARKET_CAP, FS.AVG_REVENUE, FS.AVG_NET_INCOME, COALESCE(PRC.PRESS_RELEASES_COUNT, 0) AS PRESS_RELEASES_COUNT, COALESCE(NAC.NEWS_ARTICLES_COUNT, 0) AS NEWS_ARTICLES_COUNT, COALESCE(WC.WATCHLIST_COUNT, 0) AS WATCHLIST_COUNT, COALESCE(RS.AVG_RATING, 0) AS AVG_RATING FROM TOPCOMPANIES TC LEFT JOIN FINANCIALSUMMARY FS ON TC.COMPANY_ID = FS.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN PRESSRELEASESCOUNT PRC ON TC.COMPANY_ID = PRC.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN NEWSARTICLESCOUNT NAC ON TC.COMPANY_ID = NAC.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN WATCHLISTCOUNT WC ON TC.COMPANY_ID = WC.COMPANY_ID LEFT JOIN RATINGSSUMMARY RS ON TC.COMPANY_ID = RS.COMPANY_ID ORDER BY TC.MARKET_CAP DESC;

WITH TransferCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        dt.stream_id, 
        COUNT(dt.transfer_id) AS transfer_count, 
        SUM(dt.bytes_transferred) AS total_bytes_transferred
    FROM data_transfers dt
    GROUP BY dt.stream_id
),
ErrorCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        el.stream_id, 
        COUNT(el.error_id) AS error_count, 
        SUM(CASE WHEN el.error_code = 1001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timeout_errors
    FROM error_logs el
    GROUP BY el.stream_id
),
UserAccess AS (
    SELECT 
        ua.stream_id, 
        ua.user_id
    FROM user_access_logs ua
    WHERE ua.action = 'view' AND ua.access_time > '2022-01-01'
)
SELECT 
    s.stream_id, 
    s.destination, 
    s.event, 
    s.mti, 
    s.data_content, 
    s.stream_type_id, 
    s.start_date, 
    s.end_date, 
    s.is_active, 
    tc.transfer_count, 
    tc.total_bytes_transferred, 
    ec.error_count, 
    ec.timeout_errors, 
    ua.user_id
FROM streams s
LEFT JOIN TransferCounts tc ON s.stream_id = tc.stream_id
LEFT JOIN ErrorCounts ec ON s.stream_id = ec.stream_id
LEFT JOIN UserAccess ua ON s.stream_id = ua.stream_id
WHERE s.is_active = 1
ORDER BY s.event, s.destination, s.event;
sql2: WITH TransferCounts AS ( SELECT dt.stream_id, COUNT(dt.transfer_id) AS transfer_count, SUM(dt.bytes_transferred) AS total_bytes_transferred FROM data_transfers dt GROUP BY dt.stream_id ), ErrorCounts AS ( SELECT el.stream_id, COUNT(el.error_id) AS error_count, SUM(CASE WHEN el.error_code = 1001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS timeout_errors FROM error_logs el GROUP BY el.stream_id ), UserAccess AS ( SELECT ua.stream_id, ua.user_id FROM user_access_logs ua WHERE ua.action = 'view' AND ua.access_time > '2022-01-01' ) SELECT s.stream_id, s.destination, s.event, s.mti, s.data_content, s.stream_type_id, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.is_active, IFNULL(tc.transfer_count, 0) AS transfer_count, IFNULL(tc.total_bytes_transferred, 0) AS total_bytes_transferred, IFNULL(ec.error_count, 0) AS error_count, IFNULL(ec.timeout_errors, 0) AS timeout_errors, IFNULL(ua.user_id, 0) AS user_id FROM streams s LEFT JOIN TransferCounts tc ON s.stream_id = tc.stream_id LEFT JOIN ErrorCounts ec ON s.stream_id = ec.stream_id LEFT JOIN UserAccess ua ON s.stream_id = ua.stream_id WHERE s.is_active = 1 ORDER BY s.event, s.destination, s.event;

    AVG(h.heart_rate) AS average_heart_rate
  FROM users u

  JOIN heart_rate_data h ON d.device_id = h.device_id

),

)

 ahr.user_name,

    SELECT
        'Biomass' AS energy_source,
        SUM(generation_biomass) AS actual_energy,
        SUM(forecast_solar_day_ahead) AS forecast_energy
    FROM energy_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'Fossil Brown Coal/Lignite',
        SUM(generation_fossil_brown_coal_lignite),
        SUM(forecast_wind_offshore_day_ahead)
    FROM energy_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'Solar',
        SUM(generation_solar),
        SUM(forecast_solar_day_ahead)
    FROM energy_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'Wind Onshore',
        SUM(generation_wind_onshore),
        SUM(forecast_wind_onshore_day_ahead)
    FROM energy_data
    -- Additional energy sources can be added similarly
),
ForecastAccuracyCTE AS (
    SELECT
        energy_source,
        actual_energy,
        forecast_energy,
        (ABS(forecast_energy - actual_energy) / forecast_energy) * 100 AS forecast_accuracy
    FROM EnergyGenerationCTE
    WHERE forecast_energy > 0
)
SELECT
    energy_source,
    forecast_accuracy
FROM ForecastAccuracyCTE
ORDER BY forecast_accuracy DESC;

WITH 
    TANKUPGRADES AS (
        SELECT 
            TANK_ID,
            SUM(UPGRADE_COST) AS TOTAL_UPGRADE_COST,
            COUNT(UPGRADE_NAME) AS TOTAL_UPGRADES
        FROM 
            TANK_UPGRADES
        GROUP BY 
            TANK_ID
    ),
    TANKREWARDS AS (
        SELECT 
            TANK_ID,
            SUM(REWARD_VALUE) AS TOTAL_REWARDS,
            COUNT(DISTINCT REWARD_TYPE) AS TOTAL_REWARD_TYPES
        FROM 
            PLAYER_REWARDS
        GROUP BY 
            TANK_ID
    ),
    TANKDETAILS AS (
        SELECT 
            T.TANK_ID,
            T.TANK_NAME,
            COALESCE(TU.TOTAL_UPGRADE_COST, 0) AS TOTAL_UPGRADE_COST,
            COALESCE(TU.TOTAL_UPGRADES, 0) AS TOTAL_UPGRADES,
            COALESCE(TR.TOTAL_REWARDS, 0) AS TOTAL_REWARDS,
            COALESCE(TR.TOTAL_REWARD_TYPES, 0) AS TOTAL_REWARD_TYPES
        FROM 
            TANKS T
        LEFT JOIN 
            TANKUPGRADES TU ON T.TANK_ID = TU.TANK_ID
        LEFT JOIN 
            TANKREWARDS TR ON T.TANK_ID = TR.TANK_ID
    )
SELECT 
    TD.TANK_ID,
    TD.TANK_NAME,
    TD.TOTAL_UPGRADE_COST,
    TD.TOTAL_UPGRADES,
    TD.TOTAL_REWARDS,
    TD.TOTAL_REWARD_TYPES,
    GS.SETTING_NAME,
    GS.SETTING_VALUE
FROM 
    TANKDETAILS TD
CROSS JOIN 
    GAME_SETTINGS GS
ORDER BY 
    TD.TOTAL_UPGRADE_COST DESC;
WITH TANKPERFORMANCE AS ( SELECT T.TANK_ID, T.TANK_NAME, SUM(COALESCE(TU.UPGRADE_COST, 0)) AS TOTAL_UPGRADE_COST, COUNT(TU.UPGRADE_ID) AS TOTAL_UPGRADES, SUM(COALESCE(PR.REWARD_VALUE, 0)) AS TOTAL_REWARDS, COUNT(DISTINCT PR.REWARD_TYPE) AS TOTAL_REWARD_TYPES FROM TANKS T LEFT JOIN TANK_UPGRADES TU ON T.TANK_ID = TU.TANK_ID LEFT JOIN PLAYER_REWARDS PR ON T.TANK_ID = PR.TANK_ID GROUP BY T.TANK_ID, T.TANK_NAME ) SELECT TP.TANK_ID, TP.TANK_NAME, TP.TOTAL_UPGRADE_COST, TP.TOTAL_UPGRADES, TP.TOTAL_REWARDS, TP.TOTAL_REWARD_TYPES, GS.SETTING_NAME, GS.SETTING_VALUE FROM TANKPERFORMANCE TP CROSS JOIN GAME_SETTINGS GS ORDER BY TP.TOTAL_UPGRADE_COST DESC;

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME, SUM(OI.PRICE * OI.QUANTITY) / COUNT(DISTINCT O.ORDER_ID) AS AVERAGE_REVENUE_PER_ORDER FROM PRODUCTS P INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(OI.PRICE * OI.QUANTITY) DESC;
WITH TOTALREVENUEPERPRODUCT AS (
    SELECT 
        P.PRODUCT_ID,
        P.PRODUCT_NAME,
        SUM(OI.QUANTITY * OI.PRICE) AS TOTAL_REVENUE,
        COUNT(DISTINCT O.ORDER_ID) AS TOTAL_ORDERS
    FROM PRODUCTS P
    INNER JOIN ORDER_ITEMS OI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID
    INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID
    GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME
)
SELECT 
    PRODUCT_NAME, 
    TOTAL_REVENUE / TOTAL_ORDERS AS AVERAGE_REVENUE_PER_ORDER
FROM TOTALREVENUEPERPRODUCT
ORDER BY TOTAL_REVENUE DESC;

WITH MaterialInventory AS (
    SELECT 
        m.material_name,
        i.quantity AS inventory_quantity,
        i.reorder_level,
        i.location,
        m.material_id
    FROM materials m
    INNER JOIN inventory i ON m.material_id = i.material_id
),
MaterialUsage AS (
    SELECT 
        mu.material_id,
        SUM(mu.quantity) AS total_usage,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN mu.quality_check_status = 'failed' THEN 1 END) AS failed_check_count
    FROM material_usage mu
    GROUP BY mu.material_id
),
MaterialRequests AS (
    SELECT 
        mr.material_id,
        SUM(mr.quantity) AS total_requested,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN mr.approval_status = 'approved' THEN 1 END) AS approved_requests_count
    FROM material_requests mr
    GROUP BY mr.material_id
),
AuditLogs AS (
    SELECT 
        al.material_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN al.log_type = 'usage' THEN al.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS usage_log_quantity,
        SUM(CASE WHEN al.log_type = 'inventory update' THEN al.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS inventory_update_quantity
    FROM audit_log al
    GROUP BY al.material_id
)
SELECT 
    mi.material_name,
    mi.inventory_quantity,
    mi.reorder_level,
    mi.location,
    COALESCE(mu.total_usage, 0) AS total_usage,
    COALESCE(mu.failed_check_count, 0) AS failed_check_count,
    COALESCE(mr.total_requested, 0) AS total_requested,
    COALESCE(mr.approved_requests_count, 0) AS approved_requests_count,
    COALESCE(al.usage_log_quantity, 0) AS usage_log_quantity,
    COALESCE(al.inventory_update_quantity, 0) AS inventory_update_quantity
FROM MaterialInventory mi
LEFT JOIN MaterialUsage mu ON mi.material_id = mu.material_id
LEFT JOIN MaterialRequests mr ON mi.material_id = mr.material_id
LEFT JOIN AuditLogs al ON mi.material_id = al.material_id
WHERE mi.inventory_quantity < mi.reorder_level
ORDER BY mi.material_name;

SELECT M.MATERIAL_NAME, I.QUANTITY AS INVENTORY_QUANTITY, I.REORDER_LEVEL, I.LOCATION, COALESCE(SUM(MU.QUANTITY), 0) AS TOTAL_USAGE, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN MU.QUALITY_CHECK_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS FAILED_CHECK_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN MR.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN MR.QUANTITY ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TOTAL_REQUESTED, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN MR.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS APPROVED_REQUESTS_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN AL.LOG_TYPE = 'USAGE' THEN AL.QUANTITY ELSE 0 END), 0) AS USAGE_LOG_QUANTITY, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN AL.LOG_TYPE = 'INVENTORY UPDATE' THEN AL.QUANTITY ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INVENTORY_UPDATE_QUANTITY FROM MATERIALS M JOIN INVENTORY I ON M.MATERIAL_ID = I.MATERIAL_ID LEFT JOIN MATERIAL_USAGE MU ON M.MATERIAL_ID = MU.MATERIAL_ID LEFT JOIN MATERIAL_REQUESTS MR ON M.MATERIAL_ID = MR.MATERIAL_ID LEFT JOIN AUDIT_LOG AL ON M.MATERIAL_ID = AL.MATERIAL_ID WHERE I.QUANTITY < I.REORDER_LEVEL GROUP BY M.MATERIAL_ID, M.MATERIAL_NAME, I.QUANTITY, I.REORDER_LEVEL, I.LOCATION ORDER BY M.MATERIAL_NAME;

    SELECT 
        M.MATERIAL_NAME,
        I.QUANTITY AS INVENTORY_QUANTITY,
        I.REORDER_LEVEL,
        I.LOCATION,
        M.MATERIAL_ID
    FROM MATERIALS M
    INNER JOIN INVENTORY I ON M.MATERIAL_ID = I.MATERIAL_ID
),
MATERIALUSAGE AS (
    SELECT 
        MU.MATERIAL_ID,
        SUM(MU.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_USAGE,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN MU.QUALITY_CHECK_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS FAILED_CHECK_COUNT
    FROM MATERIAL_USAGE MU
    GROUP BY MU.MATERIAL_ID
),
MATERIALREQUESTS AS (
    SELECT 
        MR.MATERIAL_ID,
        SUM(MR.QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_REQUESTED,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN MR.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) AS APPROVED_REQUESTS_COUNT
    FROM MATERIAL_REQUESTS MR
    GROUP BY MR.MATERIAL_ID
),
AUDITLOGS AS (
    SELECT 
        AL.MATERIAL_ID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN AL.LOG_TYPE = 'USAGE' THEN AL.QUANTITY ELSE 0 END) AS USAGE_LOG_QUANTITY,
        SUM(CASE WHEN AL.LOG_TYPE = 'INVENTORY UPDATE' THEN AL.QUANTITY ELSE 0 END) AS INVENTORY_UPDATE_QUANTITY
    FROM AUDIT_LOG AL
    GROUP BY AL.MATERIAL_ID
)
SELECT 
    MI.MATERIAL_NAME,
    MI.INVENTORY_QUANTITY,
    MI.REORDER_LEVEL,
    MI.LOCATION,
    COALESCE(MU.TOTAL_USAGE, 0) AS TOTAL_USAGE,
    COALESCE(MU.FAILED_CHECK_COUNT, 0) AS FAILED_CHECK_COUNT,

SELECT C.CUSTOMER_ID, C.GENDER_STATUS, CS.CREDIT_SCORE, COALESCE(LA.TOTAL_LOAN_AMOUNT, 0) AS TOTAL_LOAN_AMOUNT, C.ANNUAL_INCOME, COALESCE(CA.TOTAL_CHECKING_BALANCE, 0) AS TOTAL_CHECKING_BALANCE, COALESCE(CA.MAX_CHECKING_BALANCE, 0) AS MAX_CHECKING_BALANCE, COALESCE(SA.TOTAL_SAVINGS_BALANCE, 0) AS TOTAL_SAVINGS_BALANCE, COALESCE(SA.MAX_SAVINGS_BALANCE, 0) AS MAX_SAVINGS_BALANCE FROM CUSTOMERS C JOIN CREDIT_SCORES CS ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = CS.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(LOAN_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_LOAN_AMOUNT FROM LOAN_APPLICATIONS GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID ) LA ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = LA.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) AS TOTAL_CHECKING_BALANCE, MAX(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) AS MAX_CHECKING_BALANCE FROM CHECKING_ACCOUNTS GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID ) CA ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = CA.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) AS TOTAL_SAVINGS_BALANCE, MAX(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) AS MAX_SAVINGS_BALANCE FROM SAVINGS_ACCOUNTS GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID ) SA ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = SA.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY CS.CREDIT_SCORE DESC LIMIT 100;
WITH CUSTOMERLOANAMOUNT AS (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_ID,
        SUM(LOAN_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_LOAN_AMOUNT
    FROM LOAN_APPLICATIONS
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
),
CHECKINGACCOUNTBALANCES AS (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_ID,
        SUM(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) AS TOTAL_ACCOUNT_BALANCE,
        MAX(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) AS MAX_ACCOUNT_BALANCE
    FROM CHECKING_ACCOUNTS
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
),
SAVINGSACCOUNTBALANCES AS (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_ID,
        SUM(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) AS TOTAL_SAVINGS_BALANCE,
        MAX(ACCOUNT_BALANCE) AS MAX_SAVINGS_BALANCE
    FROM SAVINGS_ACCOUNTS
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
)
SELECT 
    C.CUSTOMER_ID,
    C.GENDER_STATUS AS GENDER,
    CR.CREDIT_SCORE AS CREDIT_SCORE,
    CLA.TOTAL_LOAN_AMOUNT AS TOTAL_LOAN_AMOUNT,
    C.ANNUAL_INCOME AS ANNUAL_INCOME,
    CAB.TOTAL_ACCOUNT_BALANCE AS TOTAL_CHECKING_BALANCE,
    CAB.MAX_ACCOUNT_BALANCE AS MAX_CHECKING_BALANCE,
    SAB.TOTAL_SAVINGS_BALANCE AS TOTAL_SAVINGS_BALANCE,
    SAB.MAX_SAVINGS_BALANCE AS MAX_SAVINGS_BALANCE
FROM CUSTOMERS C
LEFT JOIN CREDIT_SCORES CR ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = CR.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN CUSTOMERLOANAMOUNT CLA ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = CLA.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN CHECKINGACCOUNTBALANCES CAB ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = CAB.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN SAVINGSACCOUNTBALANCES SAB ON C.CUSTOMER_ID = SAB.CUSTOMER_ID
ORDER BY CR.CREDIT_SCORE DESC

WITH ReportCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        r.model_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_report_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.report_format = 'pdf' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pdf_report_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.report_format = 'csv' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS csv_report_count
    FROM reports r
    GROUP BY r.model_id
),
ContributorOwnerCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.model_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN c.role = 'contributor' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS contributor_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN c.role = 'owner' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS owner_count
    FROM models m
    LEFT JOIN collaborations c ON m.model_id = c.team_id
    GROUP BY m.model_id
)
SELECT 
    m.model_name,
    a.step_number,
    a.confidence_level,
    a.iterations,
    a.processing_time,
    COALESCE(rc.total_report_count, 0) AS total_report_count,
    COALESCE(rc.pdf_report_count, 0) AS pdf_report_count,
    COALESCE(rc.csv_report_count, 0) AS csv_report_count,
    COALESCE(coc.contributor_count, 0) AS contributor_count,
    COALESCE(coc.owner_count, 0) AS owner_count
FROM models m
JOIN model_steps ms ON m.model_id = ms.model_id
JOIN analysis_steps a ON ms.step_id = a.step_id
LEFT JOIN ReportCounts rc ON m.model_id = rc.model_id
LEFT JOIN ContributorOwnerCounts coc ON m.model_id = coc.model_id
ORDER BY m.model_name, a.step_number;

WITH

    SELECT u.user_id
    FROM users u
    JOIN posts p ON u.user_id = p.user_id
    WHERE u.is_active = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0
  ),
  
  UnmentionedUsers AS (
    SELECT u.user_id
    FROM users u
    LEFT JOIN mentions m ON u.user_id = m.mentioned_user_id
    WHERE m.mentioned_user_id IS NULL
  ),
  
  InactiveUsers AS (
    SELECT u.user_id
    FROM users u
    WHERE u.is_active = 0
  )

  'Active Users' AS user_type, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count
FROM ActiveUsers
UNION ALL

  'Unmentioned Users', 
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)
FROM UnmentionedUsers
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Inactive Users',

        sp.close_price
    FROM
        stock_prices sp
    JOIN (

            stock_id,

    SELECT
        portfolio_id,

        PortfolioStockDetails

),

WITH MaxIonMass AS (
    SELECT 
        lipid_id,
        MAX(ion_mass) AS max_ion_mass
    FROM lipid_ionization
    GROUP BY lipid_id
),
LipidDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        ls.lipid_id,
        ls.lipid_name,
        ls.molecular_formula,
        ls.molecular_weight,
        ls.species_type,
        ls.source,
        li.ion_id,
        li.ion_mass,
        i.ion_name,
        i.ion_type,
        li.ion_intensity,
        li.ion_accuracy,
        li.ion_retention_time,
        lf.fragment_id,
        lf.fragment_mass,
        f.fragment_name,
        f.fragment_description,
        lf.fragment_intensity,
        lf.fragment_accuracy,
        lf.fragment_retention_time
    FROM lipid_species ls
    LEFT JOIN lipid_ionization li ON ls.lipid_id = li.lipid_id
    LEFT JOIN ionization_forms i ON li.ion_id = i.ion_id
    LEFT JOIN lipid_fragmentation lf ON ls.lipid_id = lf.lipid_id
    LEFT JOIN fragmentation_patterns f ON lf.fragment_id = f.fragment_id
)
SELECT 
    ld.lipid_name,
    ld.molecular_formula,
    ld.molecular_weight,
    ld.species_type,
    ld.source,
    ld.ion_name,
    ld.ion_type,
    ld.ion_mass,
    ld.ion_intensity,
    ld.ion_accuracy,
    ld.ion_retention_time,
    ld.fragment_name,
    ld.fragment_description,
    ld.fragment_mass,
    ld.fragment_intensity,
    ld.fragment_accuracy,
    ld.fragment_retention_time,
    e.experiment_name,
    e.experiment_date,
    e.instrument_used,
    e.method,
    o.operator_name,
    o.email,
    o.role,
    o.department
FROM LipidDetails ld
JOIN MaxIonMass mim ON ld.lipid_id = mim.lipid_id AND ld.ion_mass = mim.max_ion_mass
JOIN experiment_results er ON ld.lipid_id = er.lipid_id AND ld.ion_id = er.ion_id AND ld.fragment_id = er.fragment_id
JOIN experiments e ON er.experiment_id = e.experiment_id
JOIN operators o ON e.operator_id = o.operator_id
ORDER BY ld.lipid_name, e.experiment_date;

SELECT 
    l.location_id,
    l.name AS location_name,
    c.category_name,
    u1.user_name AS maintenance_user,

    CASE 
        WHEN u1.user_name IS NOT NULL AND u2.user_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shared User'
        WHEN u1.user_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'Maintenance User'
        WHEN u2.user_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'Issue Reporter'

WITH CodonFrequencies AS (
    SELECT 
        sequence_id,
        AVG(frequency) AS avg_codon_frequency
    FROM codon_usage
    GROUP BY sequence_id
),
AminoAcidFrequencies AS (
    SELECT 
        sequence_id,
        AVG(frequency) AS avg_aa_frequency
    FROM amino_acid_frequencies
    GROUP BY sequence_id
),
SequenceStats AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sequence_id,
        s.organism,
        COALESCE(c.avg_codon_frequency, 0) AS avg_codon_frequency,
        COALESCE(a.avg_aa_frequency, 0) AS avg_aa_frequency,
        (COALESCE(c.avg_codon_frequency, 0) + COALESCE(a.avg_aa_frequency, 0)) AS combined_avg_frequency
    FROM sequences s
    LEFT JOIN CodonFrequencies c ON s.sequence_id = c.sequence_id
    LEFT JOIN AminoAcidFrequencies a ON s.sequence_id = a.sequence_id
)
SELECT 
    sequence_id,
    organism
FROM SequenceStats
ORDER BY combined_avg_frequency DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH SeriesMatchCount AS (
    SELECT 
        s.series_id, 
        COUNT(m.match_id) AS match_count
    FROM 
        series s
    JOIN 
        matches m ON s.series_id = m.series_id
    GROUP BY 
        s.series_id
    ORDER BY 
        match_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
FilteredMatches AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id, 
        m.series_id, 
        m.winner AS winning_team
    FROM 
        matches m
    JOIN 
        SeriesMatchCount smc ON m.series_id = smc.series_id
    WHERE 
        m.toss_choosen = 'bat' 
        AND m.match_result = 'win'
),
TeamPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        fm.match_id, 
        fm.series_id, 
        fm.winning_team, 
        t.team_name, 
        SUM(i.runs_scored) AS total_runs, 
        SUM(i.wickets_fallen) AS total_wickets
    FROM 
        FilteredMatches fm
    JOIN 
        innings i ON fm.match_id = i.match_id AND fm.winning_team = i.batting_team_id
    JOIN 
        teams t ON i.batting_team_id = t.team_id
    GROUP BY 
        fm.match_id, 
        fm.series_id, 
        fm.winning_team, 
        t.team_name
),
PlayerPerformance AS (
    SELECT 
        tp.match_id, 
        tp.series_id, 
        tp.winning_team, 
        tp.team_name, 
        p.player_name, 
        SUM(b.runs) AS player_runs, 
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.bowler_id = px.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS player_wickets
    FROM 
        TeamPerformance tp
    JOIN 
        playing_xi px ON tp.match_id = px.match_id AND tp.winning_team = px.team_id
    JOIN 
        players p ON px.player_id = p.player_id
    JOIN 
        balls b ON px.match_id = b.innings_id AND px.player_id = b.batsman_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        dismissals d ON b.ball_id = d.ball_id AND px.player_id = d.bowler_id
    GROUP BY 
        tp.match_id, 
        tp.series_id, 
        tp.winning_team, 
        tp.team_name, 
        p.player_name
)
SELECT 
    pp.winning_team, 
    pp.team_name, 
    SUM(pp.player_runs) AS total_runs, 
    SUM(pp.player_wickets) AS total_wickets, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT pp.match_id) AS matches_won, 
    SUM(tp.total_runs) AS team_total_runs, 
    SUM(tp.total_wickets) AS team_total_wickets
FROM 
    PlayerPerformance pp
JOIN 
    TeamPerformance tp ON pp.match_id = tp.match_id AND pp.winning_team = tp.winning_team
GROUP BY 
    pp.winning_team, 
    pp.team_name
ORDER BY 
    matches_won DESC, 
    total_runs DESC, 
    total_wickets DESC;

WITH SERIESMATCHCOUNT AS (
    SELECT 
        S.SERIES_ID, 
        COUNT(M.MATCH_ID) AS MATCH_COUNT
    FROM 
        SERIES S
    JOIN 
        MATCHES M ON S.SERIES_ID = M.SERIES_ID
    GROUP BY 
        S.SERIES_ID
    ORDER BY 
        MATCH_COUNT DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
FILTEREDMATCHES AS (
    SELECT 
        M.MATCH_ID, 
        M.SERIES_ID, 
        M.WINNER AS WINNING_TEAM
    FROM 
        MATCHES M
    JOIN 
        SERIESMATCHCOUNT SMC ON M.SERIES_ID = SMC.SERIES_ID
    WHERE 
        M.TOSS_CHOOSEN = 'BAT' 
        AND M.MATCH_RESULT = 'WIN'
),
TEAMPERFORMANCE AS (
    SELECT 
        FM.MATCH_ID, 
        FM.SERIES_ID, 
        FM.WINNING_TEAM, 
        T.TEAM_NAME, 
        SUM(I.RUNS_SCORED) AS TOTAL_RUNS, 
        SUM(I.WICKETS_FALLEN) AS TOTAL_WICKETS
    FROM 
        FILTEREDMATCHES FM
    JOIN 
        INNINGS I ON FM.MATCH_ID = I.MATCH_ID AND FM.WINNING_TEAM = I.BATTING_TEAM_ID
    JOIN 
        TEAMS T ON I.BATTING_TEAM_ID = T.TEAM_ID
    GROUP BY 
        FM.MATCH_ID, 
        FM.SERIES_ID, 
        FM.WINNING_TEAM, 
        T.TEAM_NAME
),
PLAYERPERFORMANCE AS (
    SELECT 
        TP.MATCH_ID, 
        TP.SERIES_ID, 
        TP.WINNING_TEAM, 
        TP.TEAM_NAME, 
        P.PLAYER_NAME, 
        SUM(B.RUNS) AS PLAYER_RUNS, 
        SUM(CASE WHEN D.BOWLER_ID = PX.PLAYER_ID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PLAYER_WICKETS
    FROM 
        TEAMPERFORMANCE TP
    JOIN 
        PLAYING_XI PX ON TP.MATCH_ID = PX.MATCH_ID AND TP.WINNING_TEAM = PX.TEAM_ID
    JOIN 
        PLAYERS P ON PX.PLAYER_ID = P.PLAYER_ID
    JOIN 
        BALLS B ON PX.MATCH_ID = B.INNINGS_ID AND PX.PLAYER_ID = B.BATSMAN_ID
    LEFT JOIN 
        DISMISSALS D ON B.BALL_ID = D.BALL_ID AND PX.PLAYER_ID = D.BOWLER_ID
    GROUP BY 
        TP.MATCH_ID, 
        TP.SERIES_ID, 
        TP.WINNING_TEAM, 
        TP.TEAM_NAME, 
        P.PLAYER_NAME
)
SELECT 
    PP.WINNING_TEAM, 
    PP.TEAM_NAME, 
    SUM(PP.PLAYER_RUNS) AS TOTAL_RUNS, 
    SUM(PP.PLAYER_WICKETS) AS TOTAL_WICKETS, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT PP.MATCH_ID) AS MATCHES_WON, 
    SUM(TP.TOTAL_RUNS) AS TEAM_TOTAL_RUNS, 
    SUM(TP.TOTAL_WICKETS) AS TEAM_TOTAL_WICKETS
FROM 
    PLAYERPERFORMANCE PP
JOIN 
    TEAMPERFORMANCE TP ON PP.MATCH_ID = TP.MATCH_ID AND PP.WINNING_TEAM = TP.WINNING_TEAM
GROUP BY 
    PP.WINNING_TEAM, 
    PP.TEAM_NAME
ORDER BY 
    MATCHES_WON DESC, 
    TOTAL_RUNS DESC, 
    TOTAL_WICKETS DESC;

P.PLAYER_NAME ), AGGREGATEDDATA AS ( SELECT PP.WINNING_TEAM, PP.TEAM_NAME, SUM(PP.PLAYER_RUNS) AS TOTAL_RUNS, SUM(PP.PLAYER_WICKETS) AS TOTAL_WICKETS, COUNT(DISTINCT PP.MATCH_ID) AS MATCHES_WON FROM sql1: WITH NeurologyResidents AS ( SELECT r.resident_id, r.name FROM residents r JOIN specialties s ON r.specialty_id = s.specialty_id WHERE s.specialty_name = 'Neurology' ), ResidentRotationCounts AS ( SELECT r.resident_id, COUNT(rp.progress_id) AS rotation_count FROM NeurologyResidents r LEFT JOIN resident_progress rp ON r.resident_id = rp.resident_id GROUP BY r.resident_id ), QualifiedNeurologyResidents AS ( SELECT resident_id FROM ResidentRotationCounts WHERE rotation_count > 1 ), HighestScoresPerRotation AS ( SELECT rp.resident_id, rp.progress_id, MAX(re.evaluation_score) AS max_score FROM resident_progress rp JOIN rotation_evaluations re ON rp.progress_id = re.progress_id WHERE rp.resident_id IN (SELECT resident_id FROM QualifiedNeurologyResidents) GROUP BY rp.resident_id, rp.progress_id ), AverageOfHighestScores AS ( SELECT resident_id, AVG(max_score) AS avg_highest_evaluation_score FROM HighestScoresPerRotation GROUP BY resident_id ) SELECT a.resident_id, a.avg_highest_evaluation_score FROM AverageOfHighestScores a ORDER BY a.avg_highest_evaluation_score DESC;

    COALESCE(u.role, '') AS latest_user_role,

    COALESCE(fb.rating, 0) AS latest_feedback_rating

        project_id, 
        update_date, 
        update_notes, 
        next_steps, 
        responsible_user_id, 
        progress_percentage
    FROM project_management
    WHERE (project_id, update_date) IN (
        SELECT project_id, MAX(update_date)
        FROM project_management

        comments,

        SELECT project_id, MAX(feedback_date)

        GROUP BY project_id

SELECT

    P.STATUS,
    P.REGION,
    P.REF_NO,
    P.BENEFICIARY_GROUP,
    P.SOURCE,
    P.BUDGET,
    P.START_DATE,
    P.END_DATE,
    P.PROJECT_MANAGER_ID,
    P.EXTERNAL_DB_LINK,
    COALESCE(PM.UPDATE_DATE, '') AS LATEST_UPDATE_DATE,
    COALESCE(PM.UPDATE_NOTES, '') AS LATEST_UPDATE_NOTES,
    COALESCE(PM.NEXT_STEPS, '') AS LATEST_NEXT_STEPS,
    COALESCE(PM.RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID, 0) AS LATEST_RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID,
    COALESCE(PM.PROGRESS_PERCENTAGE, '') AS LATEST_PROGRESS_PERCENTAGE,
    COALESCE(U.USER_NAME, '') AS LATEST_USER_NAME,
    COALESCE(U.ROLE, '') AS LATEST_USER_ROLE,
    COALESCE(FB.COMMENTS, '') AS LATEST_FEEDBACK_COMMENTS,
    COALESCE(FB.RATING, 0) AS LATEST_FEEDBACK_RATING
FROM PROJECTS P
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        PROJECT_ID, 
        UPDATE_DATE, 
        UPDATE_NOTES, 
        NEXT_STEPS, 
        RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID, 
        PROGRESS_PERCENTAGE
    FROM PROJECT_MANAGEMENT
    WHERE (PROJECT_ID, UPDATE_DATE) IN (
        SELECT PROJECT_ID, MAX(UPDATE_DATE)
        FROM PROJECT_MANAGEMENT
        GROUP BY PROJECT_ID
    )
) PM ON P.PROJECT_ID = PM.PROJECT_ID
LEFT JOIN USERS U ON PM.RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID = U.USER_ID
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        PROJECT_ID, 
        COMMENTS, 
        RATING
    FROM FEEDBACK
    WHERE (PROJECT_ID, FEEDBACK_DATE) IN (
        SELECT PROJECT_ID, MAX(FEEDBACK_DATE)
        FROM FEEDBACK
        GROUP BY PROJECT_ID
    )
) FB ON P.PROJECT_ID = FB.PROJECT_ID
WHERE P.STATUS = 'OPEN'
ORDER BY PM.UPDATE_DATE DESC, P.PROJECT_ID;

    SELECT 
        v.video_id,
        v.filename,
        COALESCE(SUM(vv.view_duration_seconds), 0) AS total_view_time,
        COALESCE(COUNT(l.like_id), 0) AS like_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(vv.view_duration_seconds), 0) + COALESCE(COUNT(l.like_id), 0) AS engagement_score
    FROM 
        videos v
    LEFT JOIN 
        video_views vv ON v.video_id = vv.video_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        likes l ON v.video_id = l.video_id
    GROUP BY 
        v.video_id, v.filename
)

    filename,
    engagement_score
FROM 
    VideoEngagement
ORDER BY 
    engagement_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

    SELECT 
        f.airline_id,
        fa.fuel_used,
        f.flight_distance,

    FROM flights f
    INNER JOIN flight_aircraft fa ON f.flight_id = fa.flight_id

ORDER BY average_fuel_efficiency ASC;

-- Step 1: Calculate the total delay duration for each flight
WITH TotalFlightDelays AS (
  SELECT 
    f.airline_id,
    f.flight_id,
    SUM(d.duration) AS total_delay_duration
  FROM flights f
  JOIN delays_and_cancellations d ON f.flight_id = d.flight_id
  GROUP BY f.airline_id, f.flight_id
)

-- Step 2: Join the above CTE with the airlines table to get airline names
SELECT 
  a.name AS airline_name,
  tfd.flight_id,
  tfd.total_delay_duration
FROM TotalFlightDelays tfd
JOIN airlines a ON tfd.airline_id = a.airline_id
ORDER BY tfd.total_delay_duration DESC;

WITH AdoptionStatus AS (
  SELECT 
    A.animal_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN A.adoption_status = 'Available' THEN 'Available'
      WHEN A.adoption_status IN ('In foster care', 'Fostered') THEN 'Fostered'
      WHEN D.adoption_status = 'Completed' THEN 'Adopted'
      ELSE 'Available' -- Default to 'Available' if no other conditions match
    END AS status
  FROM 
    animals A
    LEFT JOIN adoptions D ON A.animal_id = D.animal_id AND D.adoption_status = 'Completed'
)
SELECT 
  status,
  COUNT(animal_id) AS animal_count
FROM 
  AdoptionStatus
GROUP BY 
  status;

sql1: SELECT T.team_initial AS team, (CASE WHEN G.home_team_id = T.team_id THEN G.home_points - G.vis_points ELSE G.vis_points - G.home_points END) - (CASE WHEN G.home_team_id = T.team_id THEN G.exp_score_home - G.exp_score_vis ELSE G.exp_score_vis - G.exp_score_home END) AS outperformance FROM games G JOIN teams T ON (G.home_team_id = T.team_id OR G.vis_team_id = T.team_id) WHERE (CASE WHEN G.home_team_id = T.team_id THEN G.home_points - G.vis_points ELSE G.vis_points - G.home_points END) > (CASE WHEN G.home_team_id = T.team_id THEN G.exp_score_home - G.exp_score_vis ELSE G.exp_score_vis - G.exp_score_home END) ORDER BY outperformance DESC LIMIT 1;
sql2:
WITH TeamGameStat AS (
    SELECT 
        T.team_initial,
        G.game_id,
        G.date,
        (CASE
            WHEN G.home_team_id = T.team_id THEN G.home_points - G.vis_points
            ELSE G.vis_points - G.home_points
        END) AS actual_point_diff,
        (CASE
            WHEN G.home_team_id = T.team_id THEN G.exp_score_home - G.exp_score_vis
            ELSE G.exp_score_vis - G.exp_score_home
        END) AS expected_point_diff
    FROM games G
    INNER JOIN teams T ON (G.home_team_id = T.team_id OR G.vis_team_id = T.team_id)
),
Outperformance AS (
    SELECT 
        team_initial,
        actual_point_diff,
        expected_point_diff,
        (actual_point_diff - expected_point_diff) AS outperformance
    FROM TeamGameStat
    WHERE actual_point_diff > expected_point_diff
)
SELECT 
    team_initial AS team,
    outperformance
FROM Outperformance
ORDER BY outperformance DESC
LIMIT 1;

        MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM market_data

        pi.portfolio_id,

    FROM portfolio_instruments pi

)

WITH 
  AverageActualPrizeFund AS (
    SELECT AVG(actual_prize_fund) AS avg_prize_fund
    FROM draws
  ),
  
  ActiveCashTiers AS (
    SELECT tier_id, prize_amount
    FROM prize_tiers
    WHERE tier_status = 'active' AND prize_type = 'cash' AND prize_amount > 1000000
  ),
  
  FilteredDraws AS (
    SELECT draw_id, draw_date, actual_prize_fund
    FROM draws
    WHERE draw_status = 'closed' AND draw_type = 'weekly' AND actual_prize_fund > (SELECT avg_prize_fund FROM AverageActualPrizeFund)
  ),
  
  TotalPrizeFundCTE AS (
    SELECT 
      d.draw_id,
      SUM(pt.prize_amount * dpt.total_winners) AS total_prize_fund
    FROM 
      FilteredDraws d
      INNER JOIN draw_prize_tiers dpt ON d.draw_id = dpt.draw_id
      INNER JOIN ActiveCashTiers pt ON dpt.tier_id = pt.tier_id
    GROUP BY 
      d.draw_id
  )
  
SELECT 
  d.draw_id,
  d.draw_date,
  COALESCE(tpf.total_prize_fund, 0) AS total_prize_fund
FROM 
  FilteredDraws d
  LEFT JOIN TotalPrizeFundCTE tpf ON d.draw_id = tpf.draw_id
ORDER BY 
  d.draw_date DESC;

WITH LIFTMAINTENANCE AS ( SELECT ML.LIFT_ID, COUNT(ML.LOG_ID) AS MAINTENANCE_COUNT, SUM(ML.MAINTENANCE_HOURS) AS TOTAL_MAINTENANCE_HOURS, MAX(ML.MAINTENANCE_DATE) AS LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE FROM MAINTENANCE_LOGS ML WHERE ML.RESORT_ID = 1 GROUP BY ML.LIFT_ID ) SELECT R.RESORT_NAME, L.LIFT_NAME, LS.STATE_NAME AS CURRENT_OP_STATE, L.CAPACITY, L.LENGTH, L.ELEVATION_GAIN, L.SPEED, S.SEASON_NAME, S.START_DATE AS SEASON_START, S.END_DATE AS SEASON_END, LOP.CHANGE_DATE, LOP.PREVIOUS_STATE, LOP.NEW_STATE, LOP.CHANGED_BY_STAFF_ID, COALESCE(LM.MAINTENANCE_COUNT, 0) AS MAINTENANCE_COUNT, COALESCE(LM.TOTAL_MAINTENANCE_HOURS, 0) AS TOTAL_MAINTENANCE_HOURS, LM.LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE FROM LIFTS L JOIN RESORTS R ON L.RESORT_ID = R.RESORT_ID AND R.RESORT_ID = 1 JOIN LIFT_STATES LS ON L.STATE = LS.STATE_ID JOIN SEASONS S ON L.RESORT_ID = S.RESORT_ID AND S.RESORT_ID = 1 JOIN LIFT_OPERATIONAL_LOGS LOP ON L.LIFT_ID = LOP.LIFT_ID AND LOP.RESORT_ID = 1 LEFT JOIN LIFTMAINTENANCE LM ON L.LIFT_ID = LM.LIFT_ID ORDER BY L.LIFT_NAME, LOP.CHANGE_DATE;
